title: Red Leaf Restored
description:
Remeber the Rare red leaf bug in bedrock edition 1.16?
Well its back
body:
# The Red Leaf Restored
for these who dont know the red leaf was a rare bug in BE 1.16 (of course) that made in low end PC's the leafs red and glow without light source so i made it work with java edition and all computers

## - Progress
- ✅ = oak leaves
- ❌ = other leaves
- ❌ = Snow Biomes only

## Mod Requried:
Fabric: Continuity
Forge: Optifine

## Notes
The Resource pack is made for 1.21.8 but it should work for older and newer verisons of minecraft 

The Resource pack is Cilent-side so it safe for online

The Resource pack is in early develpment so expect missing stuff or wrong colors
